about_short_description.short_description: MNT-Halan is a microfinance lending and payments platform that provides financial services to businesses.

product.name: Microfinance
product.description: Loans of up to EGP 200,000 for individuals and microbusinesses, with applications typically processed within three working days.

product.name: Buy Now Pay Later
product.description: Consumer installment credit of up to EGP 200,000 for purchases from participating vendors, with repayment periods of up to 36 months.

product.name: Digital Payments
product.description: Electronic payment services including a mobile wallet, cards, transfers, bill payment, cash access, and loan repayment and disbursement.

product.name: SME Lending
product.description: Financing for small and medium-sized businesses ranging from EGP 200,000 to EGP 5,000,000.

product.name: Nano Loans
product.description: Instant digital loans of up to EGP 2,000 for short-term consumer financial needs.

product.name: FMCG Commerce
product.description: A wholesale and consumer marketplace for fast-moving consumer goods, serving businesses and consumers with delivery.
